JAX SIDE-OF-ARENA SARCASTIC LOOKBACK — "Are you kidding me?"
Aspect: 16:9. Duration: 4s. Mode: R2V.
Format D — emotional single shot. ONE camera. ONE line.
============================================================
 
REFERENCES:
<<<image_1>>> — Jax: young Black male, early-mid 20s, 182cm, lean athletic build. Deep dark-brown skin (Fitzpatrick V–VI) with subtle warm undertones, peach fuzz on cheeks/jaw, asymmetric small moles (one near right cheekbone, one along left jawline), faint healed scratch on left brow ridge. Super short bleached buzz cut (~3mm, platinum-blond tips fading to dark roots). Dark brown eyes with subtle yellow-amber tint, wet living eyes. Black wraparound tactical safety glasses worn on eyes (single curved clear polycarbonate lens, matte-black temples). Black tight tactical compression T-shirt, olive-drab/khaki tactical cargo pants with thigh pockets, black fingerless tactical gloves, black combat boots.
<<<image_2>>> — Octagonal training arena: brutalist concrete hall, Ø52m, 8 walls, dome ceiling ~22m, raised octagonal platform Ø45m at center (lighter machine-troweled concrete, satin sheen). Around the platform's perimeter lip runs a continuous warm amber LED light strip (~3000K, recessed). Walls: dark charcoal-grey concrete with formwork tie-hole pattern. Warm amber industrial wall sconces (steel cage, frosted incandescent bulb, ~3000K) mounted at ~6m height every 8m around perimeter. Thin warm-grey atmospheric haze in the volume.
 
ANCHOR (front-loaded, first 30 words):
<<<image_1>>> stands off to the side of <<<image_2>>> platform, weight settled on his right hip, turns his head toward camera and delivers a flat dry sarcastic "Are you kidding me?"
 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
SHOT — JAX SIDE-OF-ARENA SARCASTIC LOOKBACK:
close-up <<<image_1>>> standing OFF TO THE SIDE of <<<image_2>>> — on the WEST apron of the octagonal platform near a wall sconce, NOT at platform center, weight settled on his right hip, chest open, arms loose at his sides. Head turns slowly toward the lens — slight chin lift. Half eye-roll up. Right eyebrow lifts. Asymmetric himbo smirk twitches the right corner of his mouth. Dry sarcastic, conversational-quiet, exasperated:
"Are you kidding me?"
Faint head-shake on "kidding". Slow blink after. Camera: anamorphic 50mm at his E/W 3/4 angle (NEVER head-on N frontal), eye-level handheld, subtle micro-drift, 180° shutter.
 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
DIALOGUE LOCK:
One spoken line — <<<image_1>>>'s warm baritone, dry sarcastic, conversational-quiet, exasperated himbo register (slightly amused under the irritation): "Are you kidding me?" Tongue/teeth visible at correct phonemes ("k" plosive, "ng" nasal, "m" lip-close). Mouth shapes natural, no lip-sync mismatch.
 
LIGHTING:
Practicals only — warm amber wall sconces (~3000K) on the perimeter wall + warm amber perimeter LED strip on the platform edge. Camera on <<<image_1>>>'s SHADOW SIDE — face naturally lit from the practicals on the far side, framed from the darker side. Natural rim light + eye catchlight from the closest sconce + perimeter LED. No fill, no front light, no off-camera fixtures, no neon, no toplight. Thin atmospheric haze for aerial depth, NO god rays.
 
COLOR GRADE (60:30:10):
Cool blue-grey concrete walls + dome shadows + ambient haze (60) + mid-tone concrete grey platform/apron (30) + warm red-amber sconces + LED strip + capillary flush in skin (10). Restrained naturalistic palette, true black point in shadows.
 
STYLE:
8K IMAX photoreal. Subtle organic 35mm-style grain. Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins (natural light, controlled contrast, precise composition). Lens: physical anamorphic-leaning cinema glass (Cooke S5/i or Master Anamorphic vibe — creamy bokeh, subtle horizontal flare on hot points, slight focus breathing). 60fps base, 180° shutter natural motion blur. Skin: pore-level realism (peach fuzz, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, subsurface scattering at thin areas, fine glistening sweat film). Performance: Hollywood A-grade — micro-pauses, precise eyeline, wet eyes with catchlights, visible breath, small involuntary blinks.
 
HARD LOCKS:
- ONE character in frame: <<<image_1>>>. No clones, no extras, no other figures.
- <<<image_1>>> positioned OFF TO THE SIDE of <<<image_2>>> — on the WEST apron near a wall sconce, NOT at center, NOT on any painted floor mark.
- Camera always 3/4 from his EAST/WEST/SOUTH side — NEVER flat NORTH frontal head-on portrait.
- Identity per <<<image_1>>>: same buzz cut length, same mole positions, same eye color (dark brown with subtle yellow-amber tint), same scratch on left brow, same wardrobe, tactical safety glasses worn ON eyes.
- Environment per <<<image_2>>>: same wall pattern, same sconce spacing, same warm amber LED strip on platform edge. No fictional features, no drift.
- Performance register: himbo-cocky + dry sarcasm, NEVER stoic-action-hero, NEVER Marvel-dramatic, NEVER neutral.
- No CGI / no 3D render / no game-engine aesthetic.
 
AUDIO (SFX only, no music, no subtitles, no voiceover):
Distant HVAC rumble in the dome + faint 60Hz electrical hum from the wall sconce + light fabric rustle of <<<image_1>>>'s T-shirt and cargo pants + small leather creak of gloves + slow audible breath + <<<image_1>>>'s dry sarcastic "Are you kidding me?" at ~1.2s (FG, clear, his voice).

<<<image_1>>> character sheet of Roco
continue <<<video_1>>> with Roco, slowly raising his gaze towards somewhere far, and says, sadly, with a forced smile: "It's going to be okay". No other voices or lines

Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic.
Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.
Lighting: Natural light only — contre-jour backlight, camera on shadow side, atmospheric haze throughout. Key light from sky and windows only.
Color: 60:30:10 — dominant / secondary / accent.
Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur.
Skin: Pore-level realism — vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, pore-shadow matching on-set light.
Acting: Hollywood — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise.
Physics: Gravity and inertia respected — mass has real weight, correct contact shadows. No floating props.
Composition: Rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one.
Continuity: Characters, props, environment identical across every cut. No identity drift.
Technical: 24fps smooth motion. 8K detail. No jitter.
Audio: Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.

[CINEMATIC SPECIFICATION]
Single continuous handheld close-up shot, 5 seconds, anamorphic 2.39:1, 
35mm film grain, shot on Arri Alexa with anamorphic lenses, very 
shallow depth of field with creamy neon bokeh in background, 
cinematography in the style of Wong Kar-wai's "Fallen Angels" and 
"Chungking Express", Christopher Doyle handheld energy.

[CAMERA]
Active alive handheld camera close to Lulu's face, running alongside 
her, breathing with the motion. Operator visibly chasing her — slight 
weight, slight bounce, occasional motion blur. The camera is barely 
keeping up with her. NOT smooth gimbal, NOT stabilized — alive and 
human. Frame: tight close-up, Lulu's face fills most of the frame, 
her shoulder visible, everything behind her dissolved into colored 
neon bokeh.

[LIGHT & ATMOSPHERE]
Late night Asian megacity backstreet, recently rained. Neon signs 
above and behind her — pink, red, electric blue — splashing colored 
light across her face as she runs through them. Each step she takes 
catches a different colored beam. Wet asphalt reflections of neon 
visible at edges of frame. Streetlamps overhead. Misty air. 
Anamorphic lens flares streaking horizontally when bright signs pass 
behind her.

[CHARACTER — Lulu, 17 years old]
Lulu, 17, dark brown shoulder-length hair flying behind her as she 
runs, side-swept fringe falling across her forehead, pale skin 
flushed pink from running, bright eyes gleaming with neon reflections, 
mouth open in a wild laugh. Wearing a light wash denim jacket covered 
in vintage embroidered patches (aviation, retro, badges) over a 
white cropped t-shirt, thin black velvet choker around her neck 
visible at her collarbone. The choker and patches catch light as she 
moves.

[ACTION]
Lulu is mid-run, looking forward, hair flying. She glances over her 
shoulder, looking BACK toward the camera (toward where Roco is, 
chasing her), grinning wildly — eyes alive, completely free. She 
shouts something playful to him over the city noise, laughs at her 
own shout, then turns her face forward again and keeps running. The 
neon behind her shifts as she runs through different signs. Her hair 
catches a beam of red light, then pink, then blue.

[SOUND — DIEGETIC ONLY]
No music, no instruments. Her fast running footsteps on wet asphalt, 
her breathless laughter, the rustle of her denim jacket, distant city 
hum, faint car horns, the soft hiss of mist on pavement.

[NEGATIVE]
no music, no score, no instruments, no slow motion, no smooth gimbal, 
no static camera, no stabilization, no full body shot, no wide shot, 
no other people in frame, no cars in foreground, no rain falling, 
no melancholy, no fear, no sadness, no extra limbs, no facial morphing, 
no character identity drift, no posed running, no fake laughter, no 
looking directly into camera lens, no sharp focus on background, no 
deep depth of field, no children, no adults, no text, no captions.
